profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full stack web developer with a background in the service industry, applying skills in teamwork and adaptability to create relevant and responsive web applications. Earned a certificate in full stack development from Georgia Tech Professional Education, gaining skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, and React.js. Proficient in applying mobile-first design and Agile development concepts in projects, with a focus on attention to detail. I am always excited about the opportunity to harness my abilities as part of a professional team creating meaningful experiences for users.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Osano, a leading data privacy platform, simplifies privacy compliance by helping organizations build, manage, and scale their privacy program to increase trust, stay compliant, and do the right thing. Founded in Austin, Texas, the data privacy management company solves for consent management, data subject rights, assessments, and vendor risk — all in one place.

positions.title: Bar Supervisor
positions.description:
Trained servers and bartenders for more than 2 years.
Dynamically created weekly orders for an average of $7000 worth of product.
Infused all craft syrups, and ensured the consistency of recipe implementation.

positions.title: Acquisition Specialist
positions.description:
Developed acquisition strategies that led to significant growth in the company
Used powerful skip-tracing software to identify and contact leads.

projects.title: The Art Store
projects.description: A MERN app that allows users to sell their artwork, and purchase artwork from other users.

projects.title: Pro Event Planning
projects.description: An event planning app that emails weather data to users who have made an RSVP. Uses Model-View-Controller.
